evidence.title: CSS-Tricks - Learning for front-end designers and developers

name: CSS-Tricks
summary: Front-end blog publishing CSS, HTML and JavaScript articles, guides and an almanac since 2007.
description: A long-running web design and development publication: articles and tutorials on CSS, JavaScript, HTML, accessibility and performance, complete guides (Flexbox, Grid, container queries, cascade layers), the CSS Almanac reference, a snippets library and curated links. Written for front-end designers and developers.
contains: articles, guides, the CSS Almanac, a snippets library and curated links
published since 2007, founded by Chris Coyier and led by Geoff Graham
complete guides: Flexbox, Grid, container queries, cascade layers, selectors, color functions, dark mode
CSS Almanac reference for properties, selectors, at-rules and functions
'Classic Tricks' CSS demos (scroll animation, scroll shadows, border triangles …)
code snippets MIT licensed; written articles copyrighted
